fact: The e-Government Authority's list of e-Government standards and guidelines dated 1 July 2024 records the published Integration Architecture Standards and Technical Guidelines (eGA/EXT/ITA/001, version 1.0, November 2017) and the data sharing and exchange guidelines (eGA/EXT/ITA/002 and ITA/003, July 2022).
